rules.series: Series issued until the R series
rules.quote: The solution for the Australian book embedded the chip in a double-layered centre page
rules.note: Note Printing Australia, the passport printer, in 2018, of the series issued until then. The R series, from September 2022, is not covered.

rules.quote: other windows that include the antenna for the passport chip, which is embedded in the passport
rules.note: Australian Passport Office, archived copy: the windows are in the polycarbonate photo page. The antenna is stated to be in that page; the chip itself only "embedded in the passport".
